classification.difficultyReason: Find each triangular face height using Pythagoras, then combine four face areas and the square base.

content.prompt: Use a technique similar to that in question 6 to find the surface areas of these square pyramids, assuming the vertex is above the centre of the square. Give exact answers and decimal approximations to 3 decimal places.

spec.description: Unshaded square pyramid with apex above the base centre, visible front and right faces, three dashed hidden rear edges, double equality ticks on adjacent base sides, and an external perpendicular-height dimension. Ordinary blue outlines and red hidden edges become black; height extensions retain standard red.
spec.mathematics: Square base side 8 cm; perpendicular height 6 cm. The dimension spans apex level to base-centre level, not to the front base edge.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied dimensions and equality marks appear; no slant height or surface area is supplied.

answer.short:
$64+32\sqrt{13}\text{ cm}^2\approx179.378\text{ cm}^2$.

Use Pythagoras to find the triangular face height, then add the four face areas and the base.
answer.worked:
Let $l$ be the height of a triangular face. The distance from the base centre to a side midpoint is $8\div2=4\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}l^2&=6^2+4^2\\l^2&=52\\l&=2\sqrt{13}\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Surface area}&=8^2+4\left(\frac12\times8\times2\sqrt{13}\right)\\\text{Surface area}&=64+32\sqrt{13}\text{ cm}^2\\\text{Surface area}&\approx179.378\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$

answer.short:
$36+12\sqrt{34}\text{ cm}^2\approx105.971\text{ cm}^2$.

Use Pythagoras to find the triangular face height, then add the four face areas and the base.
answer.worked:
Let $l$ be the height of a triangular face. The distance from the base centre to a side midpoint is $6\div2=3\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}l^2&=5^2+3^2\\l^2&=34\\l&=\sqrt{34}\text{ cm}.\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Surface area}&=6^2+4\left(\frac12\times6\times\sqrt{34}\right)\\\text{Surface area}&=36+12\sqrt{34}\text{ cm}^2\\\text{Surface area}&\approx105.971\text{ cm}^2.\end{align*}$$
